data.long_meaning: Ishikaa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ish’, meaning God, and ‘Kaa’ meaning wisdom. It is the name of a goddess revered for her wisdom and knowledge. Ishikaa represents the divine power of knowledge and understanding. The name Ishikaa carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ishikaa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishikaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
